summary.en: Model fixed choices with enums and validated data values with Java 16 records.
summary.bn: নির্দিষ্ট কয়েকটা পছন্দ এনামে রাখো আর ডেটার ছোট মান রেকর্ড দিয়ে তৈরি করো।

notes: Enums need Java 5; switch expressions Java 14; records Java 16; all examples target Java 17.

sections.title: Give fixed choices and data values different types
Trace a named choice into its behaviour
Build valid records at the boundary
Keep persistence and display decisions separate
Choose a type that states the model

examples.title: Enum values carry fields
examples.explanationHtml: Each declared constant initializes its fee once. The identity comparison checks the exact named constant.

examples.title: Switch on an enum
examples.explanationHtml: Both alternatives are covered, so the switch expression needs no default for this declaration.

examples.title: Compare record components
examples.explanationHtml: Equal record components give value equality. Accessors use the component names.

examples.title: Copy a mutable input list
examples.explanationHtml: The record stores an unmodifiable snapshot. Later source additions do not change the stored list.

practice.title: A status-based fee
practice.statementHtml: Read AVAILABLE or BORROWED, then days (0..1000). Use an enum switch. AVAILABLE costs zero; BORROWED costs 5*days. Print the fee without a prompt.

practice.title: Validate a record component
practice.statementHtml: Read one integer (-100..200). Create a Mark record that accepts only 0..100. Print its accessor value or INVALID. No prompt.
hints: Reject invalid values in the compact constructor.

practice.title: Protect record contents
practice.statementHtml: A record receives a mutable List<String> that the caller keeps. How can it preserve a snapshot?
practice.answerHtml: Assign List.copyOf(parameter) in the compact constructor. Later changes to the caller’s list do not affect the stored list. Strings are immutable, so a shallow element copy is sufficient here.

practice.title: Choose enum or record
practice.statementHtml: A system needs four loan states and many receipt values. Which feature fits each?
practice.answerHtml: Use an enum for the four fixed loan states. Use a record for receipt components such as receiptId and amount, creating many value instances.
hints: Fixed alternatives and component values are different models.

quiz.prompt: What fee and identity comparison result come from the enum constants?
quiz.explanation: BORROWED carries five, and valueOf returns the named AVAILABLE singleton.

quiz.prompt: Which action does the exhaustive enum switch select?
Are the two record values equal despite separate construction?
quiz.explanation: Record equality compares components of the same record type.

quiz.prompt: Which accessor does record Mark(int value) generate?
Why avoid enum ordinal in a persistent format?
quiz.explanation: Ordinal reflects declaration position rather than a permanent business code.

quiz.prompt: What does a compact canonical constructor validate?
quiz.explanation: Validation can reject construction or normalize parameters.

quiz.prompt: What kind of immutability does a record provide by default?
quiz.explanation: Mutable component objects may still change unless protected.
The requested Java 17 baseline includes standard records.

quiz.prompt: What happens on unknown Enum.valueOf text?
options: A new enum constant is created
quiz.explanation: Only exactly named declared constants can be selected.

quiz.prompt: Can a record extend an arbitrary ordinary class?
options: Yes, if the parent is abstract
Only if all fields are final
quiz.explanation: Records have a fixed superclass but may implement interfaces.

keyPoints.en: Enums define a fixed set of named values.
keyPoints.bn: এনামে আগে থেকে ঠিক করা কয়েকটা নামের মান থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Enum constants may carry fields and behaviour.
keyPoints.bn: এনামের মানের নিজস্ব ফিল্ড আর মেথড থাকতে পারে।
রেকর্ডের অ্যাক্সেসরের নাম তার কম্পোনেন্টের নামেই হয়।

keyPoints.en: Final components do not freeze referenced objects.
keyPoints.bn: কম্পোনেন্ট final হলেও সেটি যে অবজেক্টের রেফারেন্স রাখে, তা বদলাতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: Compare an enum and a record in a library model.
examQuestions.answerHtml: An enum restricts status to fixed alternatives such as AVAILABLE and BORROWED. A record carries data such as bookId and title. There can be many record values but only the declared enum constants.

examQuestions.question: How can a record enforce marks between zero and one hundred?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Use a compact canonical constructor to check the parameter and throw IllegalArgumentException before construction completes if it is outside the range.

examQuestions.question: Why is List.copyOf useful in a record constructor?
examQuestions.answerHtml: It creates an unmodifiable snapshot of the list references. The record is isolated from later structural changes to the caller’s list, though mutable elements would still need their own policy.
